intel.title: [CISA KEV] Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in - Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in Improper Access Control Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-21962
廠商: Oracle
產品: HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in
漏洞名稱: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in Improper Access Control Vulnerability
說明: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in contain an improper access control vulnerability that can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in accessible data.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
修補截止日: 2026-08-27
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: 此情資指出 Oracle HTTP Server 及 Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in 存在不當存取控制漏洞（CVE-2026-21962），已被 CISA 列入已知利用漏洞清單（KEV）。攻擊者可藉此漏洞未經授權存取、修改或刪除關鍵資料。經評估，本公司並未使用此技術棧，因此無直接安全風險。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
